scope: Only 高津利恵 and 橋本信之; no ROM edits; no full-game audit

entries.credit: Riviera WSC Special Thanks page 9 row 3
identity_chain: Riviera original credits identify 橋本 信之 in Special Thanks. Its Bandai Sales staff are 干川 耕司, 吉田 賢司, 大野 聡.

User-supplied original One Piece Treasure Wars 2 ROM directly contains structurally bounded CP932 credits: えいぎょう： / 橋本 信之 / 干川 耕司, followed by えいぎょう： / 熊田 直樹 / 大野 聡. Exact Japanese names, role, and order independently agree with GDRI transcription.

One Piece: Grand Battle Swan Colosseum WSC credits (same stated publication date as Riviera, 2002-07-12) identify NOBUYUKI HASHIMOTO under PROMOTION immediately followed by KOHJI HOSHIKAWA, KENJI YOSHIDA, SATOSHI OHNO, exactly the three Riviera Sales colleagues.

The actual in-game promotion screenshot supplied by the credit archive was downloaded and inspected visually; all four Latin names are clearly readable. This is not a romanization guessed from kanji or borrowed from a homonym.

entries.reason: No identity-linked Latin or kana reading established. Exact-name hits outside Riviera do not establish identity. No other target-name credit found in all 72 Raido WonderSwan credit pages fetched and normalized for whitespace.
additional_checks: Japanese Riviera GBA credits omit this name, so cannot provide a paired reading.
Targeted exact-name searches with and without spaces; Sting/Bandai/Riviera contexts; 髙 and 惠 variants; neighboring Sting credit colleagues; English candidate searches.
Sting official Riviera pages identify 高津幸央, the character designer, but no source links 高津利恵 to that person or establishes her reading; surname resemblance not evidence.

One sequential scan of all 207 WS/WSC ROM files in user-authorized 208-entry archive (one directory entry), without saving ROMs: CP932 高津/髙津 within 100 bytes of 利恵/利惠; kana surname and りえ/リエ proximity; case-insensitive ASCII Rie and Takatsu/Kozu/Kouzu in either order within 10 bytes. Zero candidates, no archive errors; 30.66 seconds. This does not exclude custom-encoded or graphical credits.

sources.evidence: Exact Japanese name in Special Thanks.
GBA Special Thanks omits the target.
72 linked WS credit pages checked; only Riviera contains 高津利恵 after whitespace normalization.
Same-name web designer, no identity bridge to Riviera.
Web designer surname こうず; no game identity link.

sources.limitation: Negative evidence only for specified byte-pattern encodings, not proof of absence of person from graphical/custom-encoded credits.

entries.recommended_rom_action: Preserve Japanese pixels. Do not replace with Rie Takatsu or Rie Kozu on present evidence.
